create_blt_config: create a BltConfig instance with default patcher, encoder, decoder, and global transformer sub-configs
create_blt_local_encoder_config: create a BltLocalEncoderConfig with custom cross-attention heads, hidden size, and number of layers
create_blt_local_decoder_config: create a BltLocalDecoderConfig with custom cross-attention heads, hidden size, and number of layers
create_blt_global_transformer_config: create a BltGlobalTransformerConfig with custom hidden size, attention heads, and number of layers
create_blt_patcher_config: create a BltPatcherConfig with custom hidden size, attention heads, and number of layers
